title: Un-carrier Manifesto
slide_intent: Explain the conviction behind a brand voice so bold language has a purpose a reader can understand.
strategic_value: The emphasis on customers and challenging industry habits can give T-Mobile a consistent basis for its assertive language.
demonstration: Two columns of manifesto copy alternate small paragraphs with emphasized statements; a cropped neon T anchors the right edge.
practical_value: Evaluate forceful copy against the stated aim of improving customers’ lives.

content_islands.spec: Place the title and magenta customer-love statement above the first text column.

content_islands.name: Manifesto argument
content_islands.spec: Continue the narrative across two white-text columns with selected bold statements.

content_islands.name: Closing and neon mark
content_islands.spec: Close with a larger brand declaration beside a neon T cropped at the right.
